from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class NetIncomeData(BaseModel):
    """Consolidated net income/loss reported by one company for a specific period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported")
    net_income_value: float | None = Field(description="The net income amount as reported; losses should be negative")
    net_income_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label (e.g., 'Net Income', 'Net Loss', 'Net (Loss) Income')")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the reported amount: 'millions', 'thousands', 'dollars'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 'Q1 2025', 'three months ended March 31, 2025')")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document (e.g., '10-Q')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    net_income_data: list[NetIncomeData]
